page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the instance delivers average multi-core performance but exhibits weaker single-core capabilities. In stress-ng and Geekbench testing, multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth read/write speeds fall within the middle 50% tier. Conversely, single-core CPU performance and single-threaded operations, such as Gzip compression and text processing, rank in the bottom 10% to 25% tiers. Multi-threaded tasks, including bzip3 decompression and software compilation, perform at average levels.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance provides stable resource density for workloads that benefit from multi-threaded execution rather than high single-core speeds. It is suited for general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, Redis database operations, and moderate multi-threaded processing. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, which should be factored into the overall resource architecture.
